capture: Native macOS windows and popovers, iOS 27.0 simulators, isolated Debug preferences, fictional card and document fixtures, MSIGN_QA_NO_HARDWARE. Mobile status-bar time set to 09:41 using simctl. Crop only to remove unused iPad canvas or focus on the native macOS window or sheet.
scope: Saved documents, history, signing results, verification and signature disclosures, saved cards and file protection. macOS also includes first launch, menu bar and the automatic export folder.
sourceNote: The release source contains the approved Apple UI, and the later Mac-only credential-label commit is identified separately. The menu-bar captures reuse the approved isolated native review images.

macos.target: Native macOS main window, popover and sheets
macos.binaryNote: The hashes identify the rebuilt App Store Debug binary used for the visible credential labels and export-folder captures. The other Mac screens were captured before that targeted UI fix.

limitations: Captures illustrate native UI using fictional fixtures. They do not establish hardware reader access, real PIN use, cryptographic validity, App Store delivery or launch-agent approval.
Both mobile simulator runtimes kept English system settings. App controls and document dates use each selected language; the iPad system status-bar weekday follows the simulator language.
Mobile Debug was compiled with the approved 0.2.13 UI before the marketing version was advanced. Local debug metadata and release build numbers are independent.
The separate saved-cards management view uses two fictional records and an in-memory vault.
